evidencePolicy: Every check is unexecuted. Future execution belongs to qualified Platform owners and external signed records; this packet accepts no operational results.

Verify protected-ref source, signer workflow/digest, Build Config URI and pinned workflow closure. Distinguish published Builds 4.32.0 source/catalog (EventStore 3.123.0) from the current local catalog (3.124.0); refuse substituted inputs. Intake manifest for every dependency, composed host release-availability evidence, retained package/image identities and off-site retention references; package Release jobs never stand in for deployment records.

preconditions: All preceding checks have external, accepted exact-artifact evidence; this packet records none.

Verify keyPrefix=none and shared Server/Workers physical read-model backend; topic override folders.events; isolated inbound broker, retries/dead letters and recoverable backlog; HotReload off and Dapr activation restarts.

Qualify local sidecars, Sentry, placement and scheduler mTLS using localhost/default control-plane bindings and public workload SPIFFE ACL matching.

Render declarative subscriptions with explicit receiver/route and resolved component/physical topic/dead-letter policy; refuse duplicate identities, disable programmatic discovery while keeping delivery routes, and deliver scoped files to actual CLI resource paths for project, container and signed-plan paths. Local pattern syntax does not qualify provider wildcard support.
requiredEvidence: Profile/template and binding digests, qualified providers and durable broker evidence, declarative subscriptions, component names/scopes and namespace/volume identities.

Restricted admission and negative NFR-3 matrix covering staging access to production data, secrets, app ports/sidecars/actors/workflows, duplicate app IDs, PVs, hostnames/certificates, realm admin and automation/record/backup/recovery targets, prior-epoch credentials and restored copies.

External evidence of actual loaded local mTLS, deny-default ACL denials and explicit grants, scoped components, declarative delivery/dead letters and disabled programmatic discovery on each applicable resource path. Model/fixture assertions are not live enforcement; hosted-policy migration and concurrent-run isolation retain their owning stories.

preconditions: All preceding checks have external, accepted exact-artifact evidence; this packet records none.

checks.owner: Platform identity owner with EventStore, Folders and Projects
preconditions: All preceding checks have external, accepted exact-artifact evidence; this packet records none.

Bind the actual EventStore gateway address, dedicated workload JWT contract or absent-section fallback, receipt signing secret and expected eventstore workload; resource-bound requests need separately qualified authority enrollment and grants. EnableResourceBindingRequests defaults false and enabling it alone grants nothing.
procedure: Qualify real environment OIDC and confidential UI/workload client integration with actor, audience, originating surface and scoped token exchange; resolve Projects missing client auth handler before success cases.

Test missing/expired/wrong-issuer/wrong-audience tokens, cross-tenant/permission denials, spoofed actor/client attribution, direct app-channel access, bad workload assertion and missing/altered/expired command-bound human receipt.
Test every client surface directly and through a cross-module hop; agent/service origins never gain UI-only authority. No fixture auth or raw user-token forwarding serves as qualification.

Verify authenticated direct public mutations alone relay a nonempty parsed Bearer through FoldersGatewayHumanBearerHandler to the gateway for command-bound human receipt issuance; unauthenticated, non-mutation and missing/malformed bearer cases fail before submission. This scoped submission does not qualify general raw-token downstream delegation.

Verify Process, Project, Query and Metadata workload policies independently. Bind Authentication:WorkloadJwtBearer, falling back to Authentication:JwtBearer only when the dedicated section is absent; partial dedicated settings fail closed without inheriting public issuer or signing credentials.

Verify Authentication:HumanAuthorityReceipt:ExpectedWorkload defaults to eventstore and reject absent/mismatched authenticated workload, blank/control/whitespace workload configuration and missing/altered/expired/command-mismatched receipts. Resource-binding requests stay disabled until the actual authority authorization_details profile, scoped credentials and grants are qualified.

Within this check's existing 1200-second limit, execute the finite four-by-four Process/Project/Query/Metadata matrix: each correctly scoped operation is the matching positive, and all twelve off-diagonal operation-token/endpoint pairs must reject before protected effects. Each case has a 30-second deadline; abort on timeout or unexpected authorization.

Within the same remaining deadline, test Query and Metadata separately with mismatched resource-binding digest, target owner/domain, tenant and authenticated caller/workload; each of the eight mismatched cases must reject without protected reads, metadata disclosure or effects. A valid operation claim alone cannot authorize a mismatched resource binding. Bind exact request/authority profile and expected denials externally; no enrollment is supplied by this plan.
requiredEvidence: Distinct authentication, authorization and availability outcomes with safe status/category/trace metadata; no tokens, claims dumps, credentials or payload bodies.
Own-audience validation, app-channel token protection and workload-plus-human-receipt proofs; staging-to-production negative matrix and no identity-administration grants to application clients.

Exact effective gateway and workload-contract configuration identities, guarded bearer-submission negative outcomes, four workload-policy outcomes and receipt/workload binding results; owner-signed resource-binding authority enrollment/grants remain separate. No credentials or token bodies in evidence.

A finite 16-cell operation/endpoint result matrix with twelve off-diagonal denials plus eight Query/Metadata resource-binding denials, per-case <=30-second durations, exact-release identity and zero protected effects; safe metadata only, within the existing 1200-second check bound.

checks.owner: Delivery and Platform staging executor with Projects and Folders
preconditions: All preceding checks have external, accepted exact-artifact evidence; this packet records none.
procedure: Rehearse V1Only, Coexistence and V2Only only in isolated staging, restarting/redeploying for every startup-read route change. Confirm all three read families and v1 retirement behavior.

Verified prior v1 artifacts and exact-artifact restoration results when applicable; fresh-install failure-path evidence is explicitly separate from a completed migration rollback.
